<link href="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/dist/maplibre-gl.css" rel="stylesheet" />
<div id="map" class="shadow">
<div id="sidebar"><div id="legend">Select a layer</div></div>
<div id="layers"></div>
<div id="popup"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/dist/maplibre-gl.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/geotiff/dist-browser/geotiff.js"></script>
<style>
html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

#sidebar {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    width: 250px;
    background: white;
    z-index: 1000;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    font-family: sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.legend-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.legend-color {
    width: 22px;
    height: 14px;
    margin-right: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #999;
}

#map {
    width: 800px;
    height: 600px;
}

#layers {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    z-index: 1000;
    background: white;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}

#layers button {
    display: block;
    width: 140px;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

#popup {
    position: absolute;
    display: none;
    z-index: 1001;
    background: white;
    border: 1px solid #888;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    pointer-events: none;
    font-size: 12px;
}
</style>
<script>
const popup = document.getElementById('popup');

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: 'map',
    style: 'https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json',
    center: [38, 0],
    zoom: 5
});

map.addControl(
    new maplibregl.NavigationControl(),
    'top-right'
);

map.addControl(
    new maplibregl.FullscreenControl({
        container: document.getElementById('map')
    }),
    'top-right'
);

const palette = [
[255,255,178],
[254,204,92],
[253,141,60],
[240,59,32],
[189,0,38],
[128,0,38],
[77,0,75],
[26,0,54]
];

const loadedLayers = {};
let activeLayer = null;

async function loadLayer(cfg) {

    if (loadedLayers[cfg.id]) {
        return loadedLayers[cfg.id];
    }

    console.log("Loading:", cfg.title);

    const tiff = await GeoTIFF.fromUrl(cfg.file);

    const image = await tiff.getImage();

    const width = image.getWidth();
    const height = image.getHeight();

    const bbox = image.getBoundingBox();
    const data = await image.readRasters({
        interleave: true
    });
    let minVal = Infinity;
    let maxVal = -Infinity;

    for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){

        const v = data[i];

        if(
            v === undefined ||
            v === null ||
            Number.isNaN(v) ||
            v < -1000
        ) continue;

        if(v < minVal) minVal = v;
        if(v > maxVal) maxVal = v;
    }
    cfg.max = maxVal;
    cfg.min = minVal;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    const imageData =
        ctx.createImageData(width, height);

    const out = imageData.data;

    const step =
        (cfg.max - cfg.min) / palette.length;

    for(let i=0,p=0;i<data.length;i++,p+=4){

        const v = data[i];

        if(
            v === undefined ||
            v === null ||
            Number.isNaN(v) ||
            v < cfg.min ||
            v > cfg.max
        ){
            out[p+3] = 0;
            continue;
        }

        let idx =
            Math.floor((v - cfg.min) / step);

        idx = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(idx,palette.length-1)
        );

        const c = palette[idx];

        out[p]   = c[0];
        out[p+1] = c[1];
        out[p+2] = c[2];
        out[p+3] = 255;
    }

    ctx.putImageData(imageData,0,0);

    const imageUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

    const result = {
        cfg,
        width,
        height,
        bbox,
        data,
        imageUrl
    };

    loadedLayers[cfg.id] = result;

    return result;
}
async function activateLayer(cfg){
    if(activeLayer){
        map.setLayoutProperty(
            activeLayer.cfg.id,
            'visibility',
            'none'
        );
    }

    const layer = await loadLayer(cfg);
    if(!map.getSource(cfg.id)){
        const [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] =
            layer.bbox;

        map.addSource(cfg.id,{
            type:'image',
            url: layer.imageUrl,
            coordinates:[
                [xmin,ymax],
                [xmax,ymax],
                [xmax,ymin],
                [xmin,ymin]
            ]
        });

        map.addLayer({
            id: cfg.id,
            type: 'raster',
            source: cfg.id,
            paint: {
                'raster-opacity': 0.85
            }
        });

    } else {

        map.setLayoutProperty(
            cfg.id,
            'visibility',
            'visible'
        );
    }
    updateLegend(
        cfg.title,
        cfg.min,
        cfg.max
    );
    activeLayer = layer;
}

function updateLegend(title, minVal, maxVal) {

    const legend =
        document.getElementById('legend');

    legend.innerHTML = '';

    const heading =
        document.createElement('div');

    heading.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
    heading.style.marginBottom = '8px';

    heading.textContent = title;

    legend.appendChild(heading);

    const step =
        (maxVal - minVal) / palette.length;

    for (let i = 0; i < palette.length; i++) {

        const low =
            minVal + i * step;

        const high =
            minVal + (i + 1) * step;

        const row =
            document.createElement('div');

        row.className = 'legend-row';

        const color =
            document.createElement('div');

        color.className = 'legend-color';

        const c = palette[i];

        color.style.background =
            `rgb(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]})`;

        const label =
            document.createElement('span');

        label.textContent =
            `${low.toFixed(2)} – ${high.toFixed(2)}`;

        row.appendChild(color);
        row.appendChild(label);

        legend.appendChild(row);
    }
}

const panel = document.getElementById('layers');

if (!layerConfigs) {
    layerConfigs = []
}

layerConfigs.forEach(cfg => {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = cfg.title;
    btn.onclick = 
       () => activateLayer(cfg);
    panel.appendChild(btn);
});

// --------------------------------------------------
// Value popup
// --------------------------------------------------

map.on('mousemove', e => {

    popup.style.display = 'none';

    if(!activeLayer) return;

    const [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] =
        activeLayer.bbox;

    const col = Math.floor(
        ((e.lngLat.lng - xmin) /
        (xmax - xmin))
        * activeLayer.width
    );

    const row = Math.floor(
        ((ymax - e.lngLat.lat) /
        (ymax - ymin))
        * activeLayer.height
    );

    if(
        row < 0 ||
        col < 0 ||
        row >= activeLayer.height ||
        col >= activeLayer.width
    ){
        return;
    }

    const value =
        activeLayer.data[
            row * activeLayer.width + col
        ];

    if(
        value === undefined ||
        value === null ||
        Number.isNaN(value) ||
        value < -1000
    ){
        return;
    }

    popup.style.display = 'block';

    popup.style.left =
        (e.point.x + 10) + 'px';

    popup.style.top =
        (e.point.y + 10) + 'px';

    popup.innerHTML =
        activeLayer.cfg.title +
        ': ' +
        Number(value).toFixed(2);
});

map.getCanvas().addEventListener(
    'mouseleave',
    () => popup.style.display = 'none'
);
</script>
